what: Describe the structure of BNF codes — bnf_level
title: Describe the structure of BNF codes — bnf_level
text: BNF codes hierarchical: first 2 characters give chapter, 4 section, 6 paragraph, 7 subparagraph, 9 chemical substance, 11 product 15 presentation. bnf_level() reports level code , bnf_parent() truncates higher level, bnf_class() returns readable label chapter 5 sections paragraphs (antibacterial classes).

title: Describe the structure of BNF codes — bnf_level
code: bnf_level(code)  bnf_parent(   code,   level = c("chemical", "section", "paragraph", "chapter", "subparagraph", "product") )  bnf_class(code, at = c("paragraph", "section"))

title: Describe the structure of BNF codes — bnf_level
text: code Character vector BNF codes (level). level bnf_parent(): one "chapter", "section", "paragraph", "subparagraph", "chemical", "product". bnf_class(): "paragraph" (default, e.g. 050101 Penicillins) "section" (e.g. 0501 Antibacterial drugs).

title: Describe the structure of BNF codes — bnf_level
text: bnf_level() bnf_class() return character vectors (NA code recognised); bnf_parent() returns truncated codes (NA code shorter requested level).

title: Describe the structure of BNF codes — bnf_level
code: bnf_level(c("0501", "0501013B0", "0501013B0AAAAAA")) #> [1] "section"      "chemical"     "presentation" bnf_parent("0501013K0", "paragraph") #> [1] "050101" bnf_class(c("0501013B0", "0501120L0", "0501021G0")) #> [1] "Penicillins"                                        #> [2] "Quinolones"                                         #> [3] "Cephalosporins, carbapenems and other beta-lactams"

title: Prescribing items, quantity and cost from OpenPrescribing — op_spending
text: code Character vector BNF codes. level works (section "0501", chemical "0501013B0", product, presentation); OpenPrescribing sums everything code prefix. Use ab_to_bnf() obtain chemical codes antimicrobial names. org_type Organisation level: "national" (England, default), "sicbl" (Sub-ICB Location, formerly CCG), "icb", "pcn", "practice" "regional_team". org Optional organisation code(s) (example Sub-ICB code "15N" practice code "H81068"). "practice", Sub-ICB code returns practices. NULL, organisations type returned. date Optional month(s) "YYYY-MM", "YYYY-MM-DD" Date. Required org_type = "practice" org NULL (API refuses return every practice every month). Several dates trigger one request per date. by_code TRUE (default) one request per code code column; FALSE codes summed API one series labelled "code1+code2". progress Show progress bar several requests needed (default: interactive sessions).

title: Prescribing items, quantity and cost from OpenPrescribing — op_spending
text: data frame columns date, org_type, org_id, org_name, code, items, quantity, actual_cost (ccg, setting practices). items counts prescription items dispensed, quantity units product (tablets, ml, ...) therefore comparable across chemicals formulations, actual_cost pounds. Months organisation issued matching item absent (zeros, missing data).
